argv: SELECT CASE WHEN "file_id" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("file_id" AS TEXT)) END AS "file_id",CASE WHEN "annotation_set_off" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("annotation_set_off" AS TEXT)) END AS "annotation_set_off",CASE WHEN "ordinal" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("ordinal" AS TEXT)) END AS "ordinal",CASE WHEN "annotation_off" IS NULL THEN 'N' ELSE hex(CAST("annotation_off" AS TEXT)) END AS "annotation_off" FROM annotation_set_entries ORDER BY file_id,annotation_set_off,ordinal,annotation_off
